Every `ssoosshd.yaml` key, one page per top-level section. The pages are generated from the Go structs in `server/config` -- the same source that produces the `ssoosshd.yaml(5)` man page and the annotated defaults file shipped to `/etc/ssoossh/ssoosshd.yaml`.

| Section | Configures |
| --- | --- |
| [Top-level keys](/ssoossh/reference/config/top-level/) |  |
| [logging](/ssoossh/reference/config/logging/) | the main application log |
| [db](/ssoossh/reference/config/db/) | the database connection, pooling, retries, and query logging |
| [http](/ssoossh/reference/config/http/) | the listener, TLS, sessions, and rate limiting |
| [queue](/ssoossh/reference/config/queue/) | the log destination for the internal message queue |
| [authentication](/ssoossh/reference/config/authentication/) | OAuth/OIDC authentication for the server |
| [ldap](/ssoossh/reference/config/ldap/) | optionally enriches the OIDC identity with directory attributes |
| [admin](/ssoossh/reference/config/admin/) | administrative and auditor access |
| [audit](/ssoossh/reference/config/audit/) | how long the database copy is kept and where the durable log is shipped |
| [hsm](/ssoossh/reference/config/hsm/) | optionally sources the CA key from a PKCS#11 token instead of ssh_key |
| [pubsub](/ssoossh/reference/config/pubsub/) | the message broker behind the certificate pipeline |
| [cert_options](/ssoossh/reference/config/cert_options/) | the issuance policy for each certificate type |
| [mail](/ssoossh/reference/config/mail/) | the relay, the sender, and the local template overrides |
| [branding](/ssoossh/reference/config/branding/) | customizes the login page and web UI |
